# Provenance Consolidation Audit

The first-round consolidation can average heights inside a duplicate group. Across 1950 full-capture groups, 1105 contain multiple raw heights. Near-truth evidence was moved outside ±30 mm in 56 groups and outside ±50 mm in 33 groups.

`HEIGHT_PRESERVING_PROVENANCE_NORMALIZATION` was tested: raw heights remain unchanged and only each group's total vote is normalized.
